messages:
maya: Heads-up — AcmeCorp POC hitting two issues during onboarding. They can SSO into the console but SCIM provisioning fails with 403. Also seeing SAML audit logs show an audience mismatch error.

sam: Can you paste the exact SAML error? audience mismatches usually mean the Assertion Audience URI != our entity ID.

maya: From the customer's IdP logs: 
```
Message: InvalidAudience - The audience 'https://acme.example.com/' does not match expected 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata'
```

maya: They say our ACS & EntityID were auto-filled in Okta app. They might have used the app's default audience.

oliver: @maya thanks — two quick checks: 1) Did we give them the Dedicated callback/EntityID URL or the hosted one? 2) Which onboarding flow did we send — hosted API POC vs Dedicated pool?

maya: We sent the hosted SSO metadata link: https://console.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata/pocexample. Customer is actually testing Dedicated pool access for inference (not just Console).

sam: Ah — that explains it. Their IdP is asserting audience for the Dedicated tenant URL, but our SSO config in their app points at hosted EntityID. If their assertion audience != the SP EntityID we expect for Dedicated, the runtime rejects it.

kai: On the SCIM side: the 403 usually means the SCIM service account token is missing or the service principal is hitting an ACL. Do we have their SCIM token exchanged?

maya: They configured a service account in Okta and attached our SCIM integration. Okta shows provisioning successful on their side, but our logs show: 
```
2026-03-20T17:02:11Z WARN scim: provisioning request denied status=403 reason="service-account-not-authorized"
```

oliver: Two possibilities: the SCIM client_id in the assertion doesn't match the service account mapped to their tenant, or the provisioning endpoint they hit is the hosted SCIM endpoint while Dedicated tenants need a different base path.

sam: Can we confirm what base paths they used? maya — what URL did they paste into Okta for SCIM?

maya: They used https://scim.redwood-inference.com/v2/ which was from our docs (hosted). Customer pasted dedicated-scim.acme.redwood-inference.example in Okta as a custom endpoint (they thought it was right).

oliver: That's the mismatch. Dedicated tenants use tenant-specific SCIM ingress with mutual TLS and a different service-account mapping. If their IdP assertion and SCIM endpoint are for Dedicated but we only enabled hosted service-account for them, requests are blocked.

maya: Next steps suggested for customer: 1) Re-generate SAML metadata using the Dedicated tenant SAML URL (I'll attach). 2) Update Okta app Audience/EntityID to that value. 3) Configure SCIM to use the dedicated-scim endpoint and provide the tenant-scoped service account we created.

sam: I'll draft the exact values. For Dedicated Acme POC: 
```
EntityID: https://dedicated.redwood-inference.com/saml/tenant-acme-123
ACS: https://dedicated.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/tenant-acme-123
SCIM: https://dedicated-scim.acme.redwood-inference.com/v2/
ServiceAccountID: sa-tenant-acme-123
```

maya: Sending those to Acme now. Also noting they asked about API key access for quick tests — we gave them a hosted API key earlier. They want to test inference on Dedicated pool but can use hosted key for evaluation until Dedicated provisioning completes.

kai: FYI if they use hosted key to call Dedicated pool endpoints we will reject the token — tokens are scoped per deployment type. Host key -> hosted infra only. We should offer a short-lived Dedicated token or a temporary service account for the POC.

devops-bot: Created ticket INF-4821: "AcmeCorp Dedicated onboarding — SAML audience + SCIM service-account mismatch" assigned to oliver, due 2026-03-22.

oliver: I'll flip their tenant config to accept the Dedicated EntityID and seed the service account. Will ping when done.

maya: Thanks. I'll coordinate with Acme and update the security questionnaire entries re: SCIM endpoint and token handling (they were worried about rotating creds).

sam: Quick note for docs: add a short checkbox in Dedicated onboarding guide: "Use tenant-specific EntityID + SCIM ingress (do not copy hosted metadata)" — this keeps future customers from copying the hosted values.

maya: Agreed. I'll file a docs PR after this case is closed. :thumbsup:

oliver: Ok, flipped configs and provisioned sa-tenant-acme-123. Acme please re-run provisioning and paste the SCIM response if it fails.

maya: They confirmed provisioning succeeded after the changes — SCIM now returns 200 and users were created. SAML login also stopped throwing the audience error. Closing on our side.

sam: Awesome — marking as resolved. Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
